_doc: The release-asset data files the tests need (design rule D7: data files are release downloads, never git; setup downloads and verifies; a hash mismatch fails). The one committed source for each asset's repo, tag, name, size and SHA-256. ci/data-assets.ts reads it: it fetches into .build/data (git-ignored) and verifies; packages/db/src/street-list.ts verifies on every read. A new asset is a new entry here, and the SHA-256 must equal the one in its docs/build/spikes record (a test checks the street list).
